description.value: Gyo-O ('Fish King' in Japanese) is a Japanese seafood restaurant set in a fish market-style environment, located in a Richmond mall unit five minutes from the Canada Line Aberdeen Station. The menu centres on seafood and tempura donburi, seafood ramen, udon, and small Japanese tapas, with rotating seasonal donburis.

bike_parking_detail: 5 racks within 100m: rack at 50m; rack at 54m; rack at 65m; rack at 67m; stands at 67m.
